instructions:
1. Sit on a bench facing the landmine, holding the bar end in one hand at shoulder height.
2. Set your feet flat and brace your core.
3. Press the bar up and slightly forward until your arm is extended.
4. Lower the bar under control back to your shoulder.
5. Complete all reps, then switch arms.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your core tight to stop your torso twisting toward the bar.
2. Press in a smooth diagonal arc that follows the landmine path.
3. Keep your wrist straight and stacked over the elbow.
4. Exhale as you press up, inhale as you lower.

instructions:
1. Stand facing the landmine, holding the bar end in one hand at shoulder height.
2. Set your feet shoulder-width apart and brace your core.
3. Dip slightly by bending your knees.
4. Drive through your legs and press the bar up and forward until your arm is extended.
5. Lower the bar under control to your shoulder, complete all reps, then switch arms.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Use the leg drive to start the press, then finish with the shoulder.
2. Keep your core braced to resist torso rotation.
3. Keep the dip short and vertical, not a full squat.
4. Exhale as you drive the bar up.

instructions:
1. Stand facing the landmine in a staggered stance, holding the bar end in one hand at shoulder height.
2. Place the opposite-side foot forward and brace your core.
3. Press the bar up and slightly forward until your arm is extended.
4. Lower the bar under control back to your shoulder.
5. Complete all reps, then switch stance and arm.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Use the staggered stance to stop yourself overarching as you press.
2. Keep your core tight to resist torso rotation toward the bar.
3. Press in a smooth diagonal arc following the landmine path.
4. Exhale as you press up, inhale as you lower.

instructions:
1. Stand facing the landmine, holding the bar end at your chest with both hands.
2. Set your feet shoulder-width apart and brace your core.
3. Squat down by bending your hips and knees until your thighs are parallel.
4. Stand up and press the bar up and forward until your arms are extended.
5. Lower the bar to your chest and return to the squat.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your chest up and heels down through the squat.
2. Link the stand and press into one smooth motion.
3. Keep your core braced throughout to protect your lower back.
4. Exhale as you stand and press.

instructions:
1. Place a resistance band around your legs just above the knees or ankles.
2. Set your feet shoulder-width apart and bend slightly into a half-squat.
3. Step one foot out to the side against the band tension.
4. Bring the trailing foot in, keeping tension on the band.
5. Take the set number of steps one way, then return the other way.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep tension on the band at all times, even between steps.
2. Keep your toes pointing forward and knees tracking over your feet.
3. Stay low in the half-squat throughout.
4. Move with control, leading from the hip, not the foot.
